notes.title: Update v0.5.6
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We would like to inform you that update v.0.5.6 went live and availible for download
Changes in the game are the following:

- Fixed the most cases making timer being stucked in the end of the turn or on the end of the game session which was making impossible to finish the game. Please let us know if this problem ever occurs again at 8floor_help@creobit.ru

- Basing on your feedback on "Imagination" we decided to make the private tables free for everyone. Regardless having premium subscription you now can host your own private session and invite there your friends from you friend list.

"Imagination" team appreciates your commentaries and feedback. With your help we hope to make "Imagination" game better and better with every update :)
